subject: Access Boarding: API key seeding & first-week runbook
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Samir Rao <samir@dataspring.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Access Boarding: API key seeding & first-week runbook

Hi Samir — great speaking earlier. Attaching a short mutual action plan and a lightweight checklist so we can get your org live next week.

High-level asks from our side to kick off the tenant:
- Confirm preferred cloud region (us-west-2 preferred) and any IP allowlists.
- Share a short list of initial admin users (name + email) who should receive Redwood admin invites.
- Confirm whether you want standard API key seeding (we provision service-keys and share securely) or to bring-your-own-key via your KMS.
- Tell us if you have existing SSO (Okta/Azure AD) and whether you want SSO enabled at day 1.

Proposed timeline (tentative):
1) Thu Oct 22: Redwood provisions org namespace, seeds 2 service API keys into a sealed Hub (or hands to your security contact).
2) Fri Oct 23: Monica runs initial validation tests with your test project and confirms token/latency profile.
3) Mon Oct 26: Production admin invites + role matrix applied; onboarding session with Jonas (30m).

Attachments: [attachment: DS-5472_mutual_action_plan.pdf (PDF, 312 KB)], [attachment: dataspring_onboarding_checklist.xlsx (XLSX, 48 KB)].

If that looks good, please respond with "Confirm: region, admin list, key preference" and we’ll lock the dates.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0219
---
Redwood Inference — Production-First Inference Platform
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Samir Rao <samir@dataspring.io>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Access Boarding: API key seeding & first-week runbook

Hi Ben / Samir — looping in the implementation plan and concrete steps so Samir has a straightforward checklist.

Jonas and I will own the provisioning window. Here are the exact implementation steps we will execute if DataSpring confirms region and admin list: 

Implementation runbook (actionable):
1) Redwood: Create org namespace data-spring-ds5472 (Oct 22, 09:00-09:30 PT).
   - Create projects: production, staging, integration-test.
   - Seed two service API keys in an encrypted vault and mark keys: DS-5472-svc-01 (staging) and DS-5472-svc-02 (prod).
2) DataSpring: Provide admin recipients to be invited (minimum 2). We will send invites, they accept.
3) Jonas: Apply role matrix (Admin, Billing, Dev, Readonly) and create an initial RBAC doc in Drive.
4) Validation: Run token flow and 3 smoke tests (text generation, embeddings, admin audit events) — report back with screenshots.

Security options:
- If you opt for BYO KMS, we will provide a short SRE doc for key rotation and a one-hour assist during initial attach.
- If you want Redwood-managed keys, we will rotate every 90 days and provide audit logs.

Scheduling note: I have a 30-minute window Fri Oct 23, 10:00-10:30 PT reserved for the smoke test handoff. Jonas will run the role-matrix session Mon Oct 26 at 14:00 PT (30m).

Samir — please reply with: preferred region, admin emails, and key preference (Redwood-managed | BYO KMS). If you want SSO enabled at Day 1, let us know your IdP type and a technical contact.

Cheers,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
From: Samir Rao <samir@dataspring.io>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 17:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Access Boarding: API key seeding & first-week runbook

Thanks, Monica / Ben — quick confirmation from my side.

Confirmations:
- Region: us-west-2 (ok with your suggested region).
- Admins to invite: Priya Khandelwal <priya.k@dataspring.io>, Samir Rao <samir@dataspring.io>.
- Key preference: Redwood-managed keys to start; we may move to BYO KMS in 90 days.
- SSO: Not required for initial rollout. We will request SSO enablement in phase 2.

We’re good to proceed with the Oct 22 provisioning and the Oct 23 smoke test. Please send the invites and the sealed key handoff link when ready.

Best,
Samir Rao
Head of Data & ML | DataSpring
samir@dataspring.io | +1 (617) 555-8800
